feeds.title: The USARA Blog
feeds.description: Get up-to-date news about the American Adventure Racing Circuit in the USARA blog. Troy Farrar founded USARA (The United States Adventure Racing Association) in 1998 with the intention of creating more robust safety standards and offering high-quality insurance at an affordable price for race directors. Troy has competed in over 100 adventure races in three different countries, dozens of 12 and 24-hour mountain bike races, and the Texas Water Safari which is dubbed the World's Toughest Boat Race.

Our mission is to inspire the community around us to get outside and enjoy and preserve the beautiful world we live in.
